label: 4MP indoor mini dome IP camera
description: Compact 4 MP indoor mini dome streaming H.264/H.265 over a 10/100 RJ45 port. Powered only by PoE 802.3af/802.3at Type 1 Class 2, drawing 3.6 W typical and 4.2 W max.
notes: PoE class 802.3af (Type 1 Class 2), 12.95 W at the PSE, 4.2 W actual - a very light load. Wired only, no Wi-Fi. 10/100 only despite the small frame size.
